description: A red cloth placemat covers the table with colorful plastic dishes and utensils in front, and there’s open space to the right side. The right hand methodically clears the setting by lifting the yellow plate, cup, and utensils and stacking them off to the right, then gathers the blue plate and cup and nests the remaining blue utensils into the blue cup on its plate; after that, both hands fold the red cloth inward from the left side and then from the far edge, pressing it flat as a two-hand object and sliding it toward the right.
